Jarvis embodies a governed intelligence framework that enforces deterministic behavior through structured sensing, interpretation, and routing. Its design ensures no autonomous execution occurs, aligning with a controlled decision-making paradigm. The system's integrity depends on maintaining a single source of truth—comprising the capability registry, agent council, and operating-loop posture—which governs all actions. Each phase of the operating loop (SENSE, INTERPRET, ROUTE, etc.) is either WIRED, PARTIAL, or NOT_WIRED, reflecting a layered control structure. The absence of model calls at runtime reinforces the deterministic nature of the system. In GSI, this translates into Bayesian inference over structured state, while in GSE, it enables predictable state transitions based on these governed signals. The system's robustness hinges on preventing unauthorized autonomy and preserving the purity of its runtime functions.
